name: leading_comma_next_record
source:

name: quote_continuation
source:
program p
implicit none
integer::u
character(12)::x,y
integer::s
u=27
read(u,*,iostat=s)x,y
print *,s
print "(a)","["//x//"]","["//y//"]"
end program
